newsitem.title: LATVIA: LATVIA NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JULY 28.
newsitem.headline: LATVIA NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JULY 28.

text.p: These are the main headlines reported by Radio Latvia on Monday at noon. Reuters has not verified these reports and cannot vouch for their accuracy.
- President Guntis Ulmanis accepted the resignation of Prime Minister Andris Shkele and his government.
- Three leading parties, Latvia's Way, Democratic Party Saimnieks and Fatherland & Freedom/LNNK named Economy Minister Guntar Krasts as new premier.
- Krasts said the new government may be nominated next week, with a largely unchanged line-up.
- Latvia and Finland signed a visa-free travel agreement and expects to sign a similar document with Sweden in August.
